beats.text: MUNICIPAL: How Canadian cities keep failing the public — national investigation. TENET5 published a long-read of 52 documented municipal findings across 30 cities: transit overruns, sole-source contracts, developer money, police budgets, and Québec’s unfinished Charbonneau map. Critical pole: Montréal, Toronto, Laval, Ottawa, Thunder Bay. Primary sources only.

DEFENCE: NATO 2026 partnerships: missiles, Arctic SATCOM, spend ladder. PM release (8 Jul 2026): path language toward 5% GDP defence/security by 2035; ~$800M Kongsberg Joint Strike Missiles; Telesat Lightspeed Arctic military SATCOM agreement-in-principle; prior Arctic OTHR / icebreaker / long-range missile packages cited as context.

PROCUREMENT: CH-146 Griffon GLLE ~$800M paused for reassessment. DND: work paused for cost, schedule, complexity, and replacement-fleet planning. Official program still shows ≤$90M definition / ≤$800M implementation, FOC 2027, fleet 85. CBC 27 Jun 2026 freezes public pause narrative.

ARCTIC: Multi-decade Arctic defence infrastructure wave. Reported packages: ~$40B+ northern defend/build framing; OTHR with Australia (~$4.67B/5y class); polar icebreakers; hubs and airfields. Sovereignty narrative: less reliance on others for northern coverage.

INDUSTRIAL: Defence Investment Agency + Industrial Strategy in motion. Departmental Plan 2026–27: DIA + Defence Industrial Strategy to speed procurement, grow domestic manufacturing, modernize infrastructure. Industry messaging: jobs + Canadian content share.
